arguments:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: _docs/frontend-flows/01-landing.md
+# Flow 01: Landing and Start dubbing entry
+
+Status: initial draft; not approved  
+Date: 2026-10-22 (Asia/Qyzylorda)  
+Mode: specification only; no implementation or delivery evidence  
+Authority: [shared frontend contract](00-shared-contract.md), then the latest owner answers; retained [SPEC-001](../specifications/SPEC-001_dubbed_mvp.md) and [BR-001](../business-requirements/BR-001_custom_video_dubbing.md) apply only where the shared contract has not replaced them
+
+## 1. Purpose and boundary
+
+The public landing page helps a casual visitor understand Dubbed, hear or watch a truthful permitted example, understand the one-time welcome-credit offer, and choose **Start dubbing**.
+
+This flow ends before authentication or file selection:
+
+- a guest who chooses **Start dubbing** enters Flow 02 with **New dub** as the intended post-sign-in destination;
+- an authenticated user who chooses **Start dubbing** enters Flow 06, **New dub**;
+- no upload control, browser file picker, processing job, credit reservation, or account creation occurs on the landing page;
+- the unlisted public-result experience belongs to Flow 14 and is not silently used as the landing demo contract.
+
+The page is public, bilingual (English/Russian), and usable on desktop and phone. Exact routes, tokens, typography, geometry, motion, imagery, and fixture selection are OPEN unless this document says otherwise.
+
+## 2. Design argument
+
+The two requested design skills are applied as analysis constraints, not as approval of their defaults.
+
+### Confirmed argument
+
+| Page claim | Honest proof on the page |
+|---|---|
+| Dubbed lets a casual user perform a short scene in their own voice. | A short, playable, permission-cleared example; its exact content and comparison model are OPEN. |
+| The product handles preparation so the user can focus on performing. | A concise ordered explanation of upload, section choice, automatic processing, Record, and Result. |
+| A verified eligible account receives a meaningful first allowance. | The literal 120 one-time, non-expiring welcome-credit rule and the `ceil(seconds)` quote rule. |
+| The next step is clear and safe. | One consistently named **Start dubbing** action that uses the authentication gate before upload. |
+
+This argument intentionally excludes testimonials, customer or press logos, user counts, ratings, success percentages, speed claims, vanity metrics, exact USD prices, and other unsupported proof.
+
+### Confirmed visual direction
+
+- Light rehearsal-room character: white and light-gray surfaces, readable black text, and one black video stage.
+- No gradients, glows, decorative effects, ornamental shapes, fake dashboards, or generic feature-card grid.
+- Recording and error semantics may use red; red is not general decoration.
+- The playable example is the subject-specific visual proof. Additional photography or illustration is not assumed.
+- The page stays short. Each section must make one of the claims above.
+
+### Proposed application of the direction
+
+- Spend the page's visual emphasis on the black example stage; keep surrounding copy and controls quiet.
+- Use a clear title, one supporting sentence, one primary action, and the welcome-credit fact in the opening experience.
+- Present “How it works” as a real ordered sequence rather than repeated icon cards.
+- End with the same **Start dubbing** action and practical footer content, without a generic multi-column sitemap.
+
+These are proposed composition rules. OPEN-01 through OPEN-03 still determine the final first-screen composition and navigation.
+
+## 3. Entry, exit, and state ownership
+
+### Entry
+
+- Direct visit to the public landing entry point.
+- Brand/home navigation from a public or authenticated area.
+- Return from sign-in cancellation, if Flow 02 supports it.
+- Authenticated visit is allowed; the page does not force a redirect away.
+
+### Exit
+
+| User state and action | Required destination |
+|---|---|
+| Guest chooses **Start dubbing** | Flow 02 sign-in, carrying only the logical intent to continue to New dub. |
+| Authenticated user chooses **Start dubbing** | Flow 06 New dub. |
+| Guest chooses **Sign in** | Flow 02 sign-in; exact post-sign-in default is owned by Flow 02. |
+| User follows an in-page explanation/example link | The matching landing section; presence of these links is OPEN-03. |
+
+The landing page owns no project, media, take, result, credit, or payment state. It may read public configuration and the current authentication state through shared service boundaries.
+
+## 4. Page anatomy
+
+### 4.1 Public header
+
+Confirmed responsibilities:
+
+- Dubbed wordmark/home action;
+- English/Russian language control;
+- **Sign in** for a guest;
+- **Start dubbing** as the primary action;
+- an authenticated state must not pretend the user is signed out.
+
+The final guest link set and signed-in header adaptation are OPEN-03. The permanent app navigation defined in the shared contract must not be copied into the public header without owner approval.
+
+### 4.2 Opening message
+
+Proposed English copy:
+
+- Title: **Dub your own scene**
+- Supporting line: **Upload a video, choose up to two minutes, and record every character in your own voice.**
+- Primary action: **Start dubbing**
+- Offer line: **Get 120 one-time welcome credits with an eligible verified account. One selected second costs one credit, rounded up.**
+
+Proposed Russian copy:
+
+- Title: **Озвучьте свою сцену**
+- Supporting line: **Загрузите видео, выберите фрагмент до двух минут и озвучьте всех персонажей своим голосом.**
+- Primary action: **Начать озвучку**
+- Offer line: **Получите 120 приветственных кредитов один раз для подходящего подтверждённого аккаунта. Одна выбранная секунда стоит один кредит с округлением вверх.**
+
+Copy is proposed pending bilingual editorial review. It must not imply that every account is eligible, that credits repeat, that they expire, that a cash price has been chosen, or that arbitrary content is permitted.
+
+### 4.3 Playable permitted example
+
+Confirmed responsibilities:
+
+- show a real short example that the product is allowed to publish;
+- provide a poster or truthful ready state before playback;
+- start audible playback only after an explicit user action;
+- provide play/pause, seek, volume/mute, duration/progress, full-screen where supported, and accessible alternatives for spoken or meaningful audio;
+- never label a static poster, missing file, or decorative animation as a playable example;
+- keep the example independent from the visitor's account, welcome-credit eligibility, and project library.
+
+The example's comparison model is OPEN-01. Its location relative to the first screen is OPEN-02. The actual clip, voices, poster, caption/transcript assets, rights record, and hosting source are OPEN-04.
+
+### 4.4 How it works
+
+The sequence must communicate the current replacement journey, without restoring the removed Prepare/editing stage:
+
+1. **Choose a video.** MP4, MOV, or WebM; up to 10 minutes and 250 MB.
+2. **Choose the scene.** Select up to 120 seconds and see the exact credit quote before processing.
+3. **Record the turns.** Automatic processing leads directly to Record, where the moving video, original audio, target line, and waveform guide the performance.
+4. **Get the result.** After every supplied turn has an accepted saved take, assembly leads to the selected-section result for playback, download, and separate sharing controls.
+
+The section must not advertise manual transcript, speaker, timing, or missed-line editing; a Prepare stage; background-only audition/approval; translation; cloned voices; performance scoring; incomplete export; or studio-quality separation.
+
+Proposed bilingual headings and body copy require editorial approval before implementation. The factual quantities and journey above are confirmed.
+
+### 4.5 Welcome-credit explanation and closing action
+
+The page may explain:
+
+- 120 credits are granted once to an eligible verified account;
+- welcome credits do not expire;
+- processing is quoted at one credit per selected second, rounded up once;
+- a full 120-second selection therefore quotes 120 credits;
+- recording retries, replay, and reopening a prepared project do not add preparation-credit charges under the shared contract;
+- one-time USD packs exist, but pack quantities and exact USD prices are not selected.
+
+The closing primary action repeats **Start dubbing** / **Начать озвучку** and follows the same authentication behavior as the opening action.
+
+### 4.6 Footer
+
+The footer may contain only real destinations. Legal, content-permission, support, privacy, and terms destinations remain OPEN; placeholder links must not appear enabled. The language control may be repeated only if it improves phone access and stays synchronized with the header control.
+
+## 5. Main and alternate transitions
+
+### Main guest transition
+
+1. The visitor receives readable landing content without an account gate or full-page loader.
+2. The visitor can inspect the explanation and playable example.
+3. The visitor chooses **Start dubbing**.
+4. The client resolves the current session through the shared authentication boundary.
+5. For an anonymous session, navigation enters Flow 02 with a validated return intent for Flow 06 New dub.
+6. Flow 02 owns sign-in, cancellation, verification, linking, and authentication failures.
+
+### Authenticated transition
+
+1. The authenticated visitor chooses **Start dubbing**.
+2. Navigation enters Flow 06 New dub directly.
+3. The landing page does not upload a previously selected file or create a project implicitly.
+
+### Alternate transitions
+
+- Changing language updates all landing copy and accessible names as one coherent locale state; media-specific caption availability must be disclosed rather than silently mismatched.
+- Example playback does not sign the user in, create a project, spend credits, or open the public-share management flow.
+- Browser Back after sign-in cancellation may return to the landing page without losing the selected landing locale; exact cross-page locale persistence is OPEN-05.
+- An expired or changed session is resolved by the shared auth guard at action time; cached UI state alone must not bypass sign-in.
+
+## 6. Loading, empty, and error behavior
+
+### Initial/session state
+
+- Primary content renders without waiting for the demo asset or an indefinite session check.
+- While session state is unresolved, **Start dubbing** remains one action; activation waits for the authoritative result and does not guess a destination.
+- If session resolution fails, stay on the landing page, announce a concise error, and offer Retry. Do not open upload or claim the user is signed out.
+
+Proposed error copy:
+
+- EN: **We couldn't check your session. Try again.**
+- RU: **Не удалось проверить сеанс. Попробуйте ещё раз.**
+
+### Example loading and failure
+
+- Loading shows the approved poster and an honest loading state, not an empty black rectangle or fake progress.
+- A media failure preserves the explanation and both Start dubbing actions.
+- The failed stage identifies that the example is unavailable and offers Retry; it does not imply that the product's upload or processing service failed.
+- If no approved asset exists, the example section is an explicit release blocker, not a placeholder passed as complete.
+
+Proposed error copy:
+
+- EN: **The example couldn't be loaded. Try again.**
+- RU: **Не удалось загрузить пример. Попробуйте ещё раз.**
+
+### Localization failure
+
+- Never show mixed-language fragments as a successful locale switch.
+- Preserve the last complete locale that loaded and announce the failure.
+- Default locale detection, persistence, and fallback policy are OPEN-05 and must be shared across flows.
+
+## 7. Desktop, phone, keyboard, and accessibility
+
+### Confirmed behavior
+
+- The same claims, credit facts, and actions are available on desktop and phone.
+- DOM order follows reading and keyboard order; visual rearrangement must not change meaning.
+- All actions use native semantic controls with visible focus and descriptive accessible names.
+- No required interaction depends on hover, precise pointer movement, autoplay audio, or motion.
+- The video example provides keyboard-operable controls, captions or a transcript for dialogue and meaningful sounds, and a text alternative for meaningful visual-only information.
+- Playback state, loading, and failures are announced without repeatedly interrupting the user.
+- Language changes update the document language and the control's current-state announcement.
+- Reduced-motion preferences preserve content and functionality.
+- Text, controls, focus, error states, and the black stage must meet the project's selected accessibility contrast and target-size standard.
+
+### Proposed responsive composition
+
+- Desktop may pair the opening message with the example stage or place the stage immediately after it; OPEN-02 decides.
+- Phone uses a single reading sequence: compact header, opening message, primary action and offer, example, ordered explanation, closing action, footer.
+- The example keeps its usable aspect ratio and controls without horizontal clipping; a phone-specific crop/poster may be required once the asset is selected.
+- Public navigation must collapse without hiding the language, sign-in, or primary action; the exact phone menu depends on OPEN-03.
+
+No exact breakpoint, size, margin, font, radius, or motion value is selected here.
+
+## 8. Logical service contracts
+
+All access goes through the shared centralized services boundary. Names below describe responsibilities, not finalized TypeScript or API names.
+
+| Boundary | Input | Success result | Relevant failures |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Authentication session | Current browser/session context | Anonymous or authenticated account summary sufficient for header and routing | Pending, unavailable, expired/changed session |
+| Public product configuration | Requested locale/version | Confirmed upload limits, section limit, welcome-credit amount/eligibility wording, and credit quote rule | Unavailable or inconsistent configuration |
+| Landing content/localization | Locale | One complete EN or RU copy set and accessible labels | Missing key, incomplete locale, failed switch |
+| Public example media | Locale/device capabilities as needed | Approved media source, poster, duration, captions/transcript, accessibility metadata, and rights/provenance identifier | No approved asset, load/decode/network failure, caption mismatch |
+| Navigation intent | Auth state plus `start-dubbing` intent | Flow 02 return intent or Flow 06 entry | Invalid/expired return target, unavailable destination |
+
+The landing page must not call project creation, upload, processing, credit reservation, purchase, recording, result generation, or share-management operations.
+
+## 9. Mock truth and production dependencies
+
+An interchangeable mock may provide:
+
+- deterministic anonymous, authenticated, pending-session, and session-error states;
+- the confirmed public configuration;
+- complete EN/RU content;
+- a locally served example only if its permission and provenance are documented.
+
+Mock behavior proves only the frontend state handling exercised against that facade. It does not prove real sign-in, account eligibility, welcome-credit grant, media rights, CDN delivery, production localization, or New dub availability.
+
+Production readiness depends on:
+
+- Flow 02 authentication and safe return intent;
+- Flow 06 New dub entry;
+- an owner-approved, permission-cleared example package and durable hosting;
+- shared product configuration and locale behavior;
+- real legal/support destinations required for launch;
+- approved visual tokens, typography, geometry, and responsive composition.
+
+Former deleted frontend assets, fixtures, screenshots, and historical test results are not evidence for this flow.
+
+## 10. Acceptance criteria
+
+| ID | Acceptance criterion | Status |
+|---|---|---|
+| F01-AC01 | A visitor can identify that Dubbed turns the visitor's short video scene into a self-performed dub and can find **Start dubbing** in EN and RU. | Confirmed behavior; exact copy proposed. |
+| F01-AC02 | The page states 120 one-time non-expiring welcome credits for an eligible verified account and the one-credit-per-selected-second, round-up rule without inventing USD prices. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC03 | A guest choosing **Start dubbing** enters Flow 02 before any upload, with New dub as the intended successful destination. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC04 | An authenticated user choosing **Start dubbing** enters Flow 06 New dub without a redundant sign-in step. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC05 | The explanation matches upload -> section selection/quote -> automatic processing -> Record -> Result and does not expose the removed Prepare/manual-correction/background-audition experience. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC06 | No landing interaction creates a project, selects a local file, reserves/spends credits, buys a pack, records media, or changes sharing. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC07 | The page contains no fabricated testimonial, logo, metric, performance promise, price, or permission claim. | Confirmed. |
+| F01-AC08 | When the approved example loads, it is genuinely playable, keyboard operable, and has the required accessible media alternatives. | BLOCKED by OPEN-01 and OPEN-04. |
+| F01-AC09 | Example load/decode failure leaves the explanatory content and Start dubbing path usable and exposes an honest Retry state. | Confirmed behavior; requires implementation evidence. |
+| F01-AC10 | Anonymous, authenticated, pending, expired, and failed session states do not bypass authentication or strand the visitor behind a full-page loader. | Confirmed behavior; requires integration evidence. |
+| F01-AC11 | Desktop and phone preserve content, action priority, logical order, media controls, keyboard access, readable focus/error states, and complete EN/RU copy. | Confirmed behavior; visual evidence pending. |
+| F01-AC12 | The rendered page follows the light rehearsal-room direction with a black video stage and no gradients or decorative effects. | BLOCKED by approved tokens/composition and OPEN-02. |
+| F01-AC13 | The public header exposes only the owner-approved guest links and adapts truthfully to authenticated state. | BLOCKED by OPEN-03. |
+| F01-AC14 | Locale selection, persistence, fallback, and media-caption behavior remain consistent across the landing, Flow 02, and Flow 06. | BLOCKED by OPEN-05 and dependent flow contracts. |
+
+## 11. Verification plan (not executed)
+
+No product verification has been run for this document. After implementation exists, verify:
+
+1. **Source/content review:** trace every factual claim and number to the shared contract; bilingual editorial review confirms equivalent meaning and avoids unsupported promises.
+2. **State tests:** exercise anonymous, authenticated, pending, expired, and failed session states; verify guest/authenticated Start dubbing destinations and absence of landing-side upload/project/credit calls.
+3. **Media tests:** use the approved package to verify poster, explicit audible playback, controls, captions/transcript, retry after load/decode failure, and no account or credit mutation.
+4. **Responsive visual review:** inspect final desktop and phone renders after tokens and OPEN-02/OPEN-03 are resolved; verify the black stage, reading order, absence of clipping/overflow, and no hidden action. Specification prose is not a screenshot pass.
+5. **Accessibility review:** complete keyboard-only, focus-order, screen-reader-name/state, language-switch, reduced-motion, media-alternative, contrast, zoom, and touch checks on the supported browser/device evidence set.
+6. **Localization review:** compare every EN/RU state, including loading and error copy; verify no mixed-language success state and the approved persistence/fallback behavior.
+7. **Rights/configuration review:** confirm the exact asset provenance and publication permission, configured duration/poster/captions, welcome-credit eligibility wording, and shared numeric configuration before release.
+8. **Integration review:** prove successful handoff to Flow 02 and Flow 06 with valid return intent and Back/cancel behavior; keep Flow 14 ownership separate.
+
+Record command or procedure, result, environment, date, revision/dirty-tree boundary, and evidence location. Mark unavailable production dependencies and unrun checks honestly.
+
+## 12. Dependencies
+
+- [Shared frontend contract](00-shared-contract.md)
+- Flow 02: sign-in and session entry
+- Flow 06: New dub upload, section selection, and quote
+- Flow 14: separate unlisted public viewer boundary
+- Shared authentication/session, localization, public configuration, navigation, and media-delivery services
+- Owner-approved public example, rights record, poster, captions/transcript, and hosting
+- Approved design tokens, typography, responsive composition, and real footer destinations
+
+## 13. Open decisions
+
+| ID | Decision | Impact |
+|---|---|---|
+| OPEN-01 | Should the example use one player with Original/Dubbed switching, only the finished dub, or two separate before/after players? | Player states, copy, media assets, accessibility, F01-AC08. |
+| OPEN-02 | Should the playable example share the first screen with the opening message, sit immediately below a text-first hero, or lead as full-screen footage? | Page composition, phone order/crop, performance budget, F01-AC12. |
+| OPEN-03 | Should guest navigation be explanatory anchors plus language/sign-in/action, a minimal language/sign-in/action header, or the app navigation behind auth guards? | Header anatomy, phone menu, signed-in adaptation, F01-AC13. |
+| OPEN-04 | Select the actual permission-cleared example and approve its original/dubbed media, performers, poster, captions/transcript, rights record, and hosting. | Truthful proof, release readiness, F01-AC08. |
+| OPEN-05 | Select initial locale, language persistence/fallback, and behavior when the example lacks a matching caption/audio locale. | Cross-flow localization, F01-AC14. |
+| OPEN-06 | Approve final EN/RU marketing and error copy. | Editorial readiness; does not reopen confirmed quantities or flow. |
+| OPEN-07 | Approve exact routes, palette values, typography, spacing, breakpoints, control geometry, focus treatment, and restrained motion. | Visual implementation and evidence. |
+| OPEN-08 | Define real footer destinations and any required content-permission notice after release policy is selected. | Public-release completeness. |
+
+OPEN-01 through OPEN-03 were submitted to the Orchestrator as the three priority owner questions. The remaining items stay explicit and must not be filled from design-skill defaults or deleted frontend artifacts.
*** End Patch";
const r=await tools.apply_patch(patch);text(r);
